meta.name: digital-avatar-shopping-video
meta.description: 电商运营与自媒体创作者在需要制作商品推荐或促销带货短视频时，使用此技能可一键生成“小省导购员”数字人口播视频。系统自动协同五大智能体完成脚本、画面与音画合成，产出适配抖音、快手等平台的成品，高效搞定带货视频制作。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入商品信息，自动产出数字人带货短视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你做电商或自媒体，需要快速生成商品推荐视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn product info into ready-to-post avatar shopping videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create product promo videos regularly for e-commerce or social media

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会以「小省导购员」人设,协同需求对接、脚本、口播、画面、音画合成五个智能体,产出 9:16 竖屏 MP4 带货视频(含字幕与背景音乐),并归档到知识库。
howto.when: 当你需要制作带货视频、产品推荐视频、价格对比视频等,或做购物咨询视频时触发。

say.text: 推荐3款3000元以内的性价比手机,做成60秒竖屏带货视频
say.note: 先查知识库,无匹配才启动创作

say.text: 对比京东和淘宝的Nike男鞋价格,做45秒对比视频
say.note: 产出左右分屏价格对比的MP4

say.text: 618大促推荐爆款家电,做成90秒促销视频
say.note: 含节日画面与价格弹出音效

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude works as the 'Xiaosheng shopping guide' and runs five agents — demand intake, script, voice-over, visuals, compositing — to output a 9:16 vertical MP4 sales video with subtitles and BGM, then archives it.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask for a sales video, product recommendation video, price comparison video, or shopping-consultation video.

say_en.text: Recommend 3 phones under 3000 yuan and make a 60-second vertical sales video.
say_en.note: Checks the knowledge base first, then creates.

say_en.text: Compare Nike men's shoe prices on JD and Taobao in a 45-second video.
say_en.note: Outputs a split-screen price comparison MP4.

say_en.text: Recommend top home appliances for the 618 sale in a 90-second promo video.
say_en.note: Adds promo visuals and a price pop sound.
